Coordinate the fleets in a sector

The fleets on the order in one sector pick their targets together: a target another fleet already handles is left to it, one out of reach or too fast is skipped, a group too strong for one fleet is taken on together or held off. Every fleet reports to the coordinator whether this is on or off; off, each fleet takes its own targets. A fleet with "Share target with other fleets" off keeps its target to itself either way.
Attack responses before a fleet's own targets

When a ship or station of yours is attacked in a sector with fleets on the order, the nearest fleet that may respond goes to the attacker even while it fights a target it picked itself; such a fleet is chosen over an idle one only when nearer by more than 5 km. A fleet already answering an attack or helping another fleet keeps its target. Off, only a fleet without a target responds.
